name: Add to Cart Button Manipulation for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Add to Cart Button Manipulation for WooCommerce empowers administrators with precise control over the availability of the “Add to Cart” button on individual product pages.

With this plugin, you can enable or disable the purchase option for each product effortlessly. Additionally, you can schedule specific time frames during which products are available for purchase, along with an optional countdown timer visible to customers. This makes it ideal for running limited-time offers, scheduling product launches, and managing time-sensitive promotions.

Features

  • Enable or disable the “Add to Cart” button on a per-product basis
  • Schedule purchase availability with customizable start and end dates
  • Optional countdown timer to create urgency for limited-time offers
  • Simple, single-click control without complicated settings
  • Product-level configuration directly on WooCommerce product edit screens
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce product pages

Use Cases

  • Limited-time offers and flash sales
  • Scheduled product releases and launches
  • Time-limited pre-order windows
  • Exclusive time-based promotions
  • Event-specific product availability management
